grade: infobox figures 3121707, 13971006, 16366641; place true, population true
answer:
Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Its capital is Buenos Aires, and the Buenos Aires Wikipedia article gives the population as **3,121,707** (2022 census, for the city proper).

The same infobox also lists 13,971,006 for the urban area and 16,366,641 for the metro area.

The Buenos Aires article is still open in the browser tab.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup; agent-browser --session $S eval "document.querySelector('.infobox').innerText.slice(0,600)"
